purpose: Bind the single bounded backbone comparison required before data-study runs.
evidence_boundary: This packet fixes the comparison and accounting contract. It does not select a production backbone, authorize GPU work or create a broad architecture search.

budget.accounting: Charge startup, validation, checkpoints, profiling, evaluation, retries and allocated idle time once. CPU acquisition and storage are logged separately.

common_contract.arms: Use exactly two complete backbone designs and one declared seed. No intermediate geometry search or extra architecture arm.
common_contract.data: Use the same qualified corpus, tokenizer, order policy, sequence length, objective, optimizer policy and token horizon after those inputs are bound. The corpus must be eligible for the comparison; this packet does not admit sources.
common_contract.initialization: Use the same declared seed and initialization policy where shapes permit; different geometries cannot have identical tensors. Record every configuration and checkpoint hash.
common_contract.quality: Evaluate matched exposure on held-out source/domain loss and a fixed development capability panel. Bind the acceptable regression tolerance before launch.
common_contract.efficiency: Report actual parameters, estimated FLOPs, precision, implementation, allocated GPU-hours, throughput, peak memory and inference measurements. Equal parameter counts do not equal equal FLOPs.
common_contract.boundary: The comparison tests complete backbone packages. It cannot isolate KDA, NoPE, RoPE or feed-forward width.

arms.geometry_rule: Replace all mixing layers with global GQA, retain depth/width/tokenizer and choose the nearest parameter match on the 256-wide SwiGLU grid.
arms.claim_boundary: The wider feed-forward layers and full RoPE are part of this complete control; no isolated mechanism claim.

training.token_horizon: bind_after measured runtime and eligible-corpus checks; same horizon for both arms
required_outputs: held-out source/domain loss at matched exposure
actual total, active and non-embedding parameters
estimated training FLOPs and precision/runtime metadata
prefill latency and time to first token
profiling.boundary: These measurements establish deployment cost only; they do not establish long-context capability.

gates_before_launch: Both configurations and implementation identities are hash-bound.
The common eligible corpus, tokenizer, objective, horizon and evaluation panel are bound.
Quality-regression tolerance and deployment cost endpoints are recorded before execution.
The four-worker/runtime environment and recovery destination are qualified sufficiently for the declared run.
The 200-hour envelope is affordable after preparation, evaluation, retries and idle time.
decision.selection: Select a qualified affordable backbone that passes the predeclared quality and cost gates. If evidence is inconclusive and the reference passes, retain the reference. If neither passes, stop and record a scope revision.
decision.claim_boundary: One seed supports a bounded design decision, not architectural superiority or a scaling law. Remeasure the selected backbone before data comparisons.

required_outputs_for_report: Exact configurations, hashes, seed, corpus and token horizon
Quality and retention curves at matched exposure
Training and inference cost tables with hardware and precision
Memory, restart and backend qualification results
Final backbone selection receipt and limitations
boundary: No architecture result is launch-ready from this packet. The first release permits this one bounded comparison; MoE, attention residuals, broad attention searches and size sweeps remain deferred.
